_note: Pinned Ed25519 witness verifier keys, in c2sp vkey form name+keyid+base64(0x04||pubkey). Each collected from the witness operator's OWN published key page (cited). submit_witnesses.py verifies every returned cosignature against these before publishing it; an unpinned or failing cosignature is NOT published. To add a witness, pin its key here first.
note: in_trust_root marks whether trust-root.json, the signed manifest, names this witness. Every key here is shipped so that every cosignature line on a checkpoint can be checked; only the ones the manifest names count toward witness_quorum. This file is not itself signed, so it must not be able to widen the quorum's key set.
